title: Legal compensation (Belgium)
subtitle: Compensation owed for a total service interruption of 8 hours or more.
legal_basis: Article 113/2 of the Belgian electronic communications act, in force since 1 November 2024.
scope_total_only: This scheme covers a total and continuous interruption only. Degraded throughput, weak Wi-Fi or a partially available service open no right to it.
scope_speed_pointer: For a degradation rather than an outage, see the mediation module: the route is a complaint, not this scale.
clock_note: The legal clock starts when the operator becomes aware of the interruption -- notification to the BIPT, or the first report by a user. Not when your line went down. Report an outage to support immediately, even when it looks obvious.
none_found: No interruption reaching 8 hours in this window.
not_qualified: Observed duration, not the legal duration: enter the time you reported the outage to compute what is actually owed.
result_below: Below the 8-hour threshold: no compensation under this scheme.
result_force_majeure: No compensation is owed for an interruption caused by force majeure.
floor_applied: Floor applied: one thirtieth of the monthly fee exceeds the scale.
verify: Amounts and conditions must be verified against the BIPT page before they go into a letter.
